title: Morning rush in Berlin: every train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Berlin, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every train inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Berlin city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: U-Bahn, S-Bahn and Regional.

Busiest moment of the morning: 291 trains at 7:59 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable.
